t2.title: Schools teach financial literacy as a mandatory subject
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should schools teach financial literacy as a mandatory subject?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Financial literacy is an essential life skill that many young people lack. I strongly believe schools should teach it as a mandatory subject.

Firstly, many adults struggle with personal finances because they were never taught basic concepts like budgeting, saving, and understanding credit scores. Teaching these skills early would prepare students for financial independence and help them avoid debt problems later in life.

Secondly, financial education promotes responsible decision-making. Students who understand compound interest and investment basics are more likely to start saving early and make informed choices about loans and purchases.

Some argue that parents should teach financial skills at home. However, not all parents have adequate financial knowledge themselves, creating inequality in financial education.

Furthermore, practical subjects like financial literacy could engage students who find traditional academic subjects less interesting.

In conclusion, teaching financial literacy in schools would benefit individuals and society by creating more financially responsible citizens. It should be considered as important as mathematics or science.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
School teach money? Yes, good. I like money. I want to learn.
Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
I think schools should teach about money. It is important. I don't know about money now. I want to learn how to save money. And how to buy a house. It is hard. But I think it is good for schools to teach it because it is useful. My parents don't teach me.
Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
I think schools should teach financial literacy. It's important for everyone to know about money. For example, how to budget and save. If schools teach this, students will be better prepared for the future.

In my opinion, it's also important to understand credit cards and loans. Many young people get into debt because they don't understand how these things work. So, teaching financial literacy could help prevent this. However, some people say that parents should teach their children about money. But not all parents know enough about it themselves.

Therefore, I think it's a good idea for schools to make financial literacy a mandatory subject.
t2.sampleB2: Great question — this is something I feel really strongly about, so I couldn't resist joining in. In my view, schools absolutely should teach financial literacy as a mandatory subject. Far too many young people leave school without the faintest idea of how to manage money, and they end up learning the hard way. I still remember friends who ran up huge debts simply because nobody ever explained how credit cards or interest actually work. If we taught practical skills like budgeting, saving and understanding loans, students would be far better prepared for real life. Knowing how compound interest works, for instance, can encourage people to start saving early rather than spending everything at once. Some argue that parents should cover this at home, but let's be honest — not every parent knows enough about money themselves, which only widens the gap between families. At the end of the day, being good with money is a life skill that everyone needs, no matter what career they choose. Schools would be doing students a huge favour by making it compulsory. What does everyone else think? Has anyone actually been taught this at school?
t2.uzSample:
Moliyaviy savodxonlik ko'plab yoshlarga yetishmaydigan muhim hayotiy ko'nikmadir. Men maktablar buni majburiy fan sifatida o'qitishi kerak, deb qat'iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, ko'plab kattalar shaxsiy moliya bilan kurashadilar, chunki ularga byudjetlashtirish, jamg'arish va kredit ballarini tushunish kabi asosiy tushunchalar o'rgatilmagan. Ushbu ko'nikmalarni erta o'rgatish talabalarni moliyaviy mustaqillikka tayyorlaydi va ularga keyinchalik qarz muammolaridan qochishga yordam beradi.

Ikkinchidan, moliyaviy ta'lim mas'uliyatli qaror qabul qilishga yordam beradi. Murakkab foiz va investitsiya asoslarini tushunadigan talabalar erta jamg'arishni boshlashadi va kreditlar va xaridlar haqida ongli ravishda qaror qabul qilishadi.

Ba'zilar ota-onalar moliyaviy ko'nikmalarni uyda o'rgatishi kerak, deb ta'kidlashadi. Biroq, barcha ota-onalarning o'zlari yetarli moliyaviy bilimga ega emas, bu esa moliyaviy ta'limda tengsizlikni yaratadi.

Bundan tashqari, moliyaviy savodxonlik kabi amaliy fanlar an'anaviy akademik fanlarni kamroq qiziqarli deb biladigan talabalarni jalb qilishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, maktablarda moliyaviy savodxonlikni o'qitish moliyaviy jihatdan mas'uliyatli fuqarolarni yaratish orqali shaxslarga va jamiyatga foyda keltiradi. Buni matematika yoki fan kabi muhim deb hisoblash kerak.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Maktab pulni o'rgatishi kerakmi? Ha, yaxshi. Menga pul yoqadi. Men o'rganmoqchiman.
Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Menimcha, maktablar pul haqida o'rgatishi kerak. Bu muhim. Men hozir pul haqida bilmayman. Men pulni qanday tejashni o'rganmoqchiman. Va qanday qilib uy sotib olishni. Bu qiyin. Lekin menimcha, maktablar buni o'rgatishi yaxshi, chunki bu foydali. Ota-onam menga o'rgatmaydi.
Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, maktablar moliyaviy savodxonlikni o'rgatishi kerak. Bu har bir kishi uchun pul haqida bilish muhim. Masalan, qanday qilib byudjet tuzish va tejash. Agar maktablar buni o'rgatsa, o'quvchilar kelajakka yaxshiroq tayyorlanadi.

Mening fikrimcha, kredit kartalari va kreditlarni tushunish ham muhim. Ko'p yoshlar bu narsalar qanday ishlashini tushunmagani uchun qarzga botadi. Shunday qilib, moliyaviy savodxonlikni o'rgatish bunga yo'l qo'ymaslikka yordam berishi mumkin. Biroq, ba'zi odamlar ota-onalar farzandlariga pul haqida o'rgatishi kerak deyishadi. Lekin hamma ota-onalar ham bu haqda yetarli ma'lumotga ega emas.

Shuning uchun, men maktablar moliyaviy savodxonlikni majburiy fan qilishlari yaxshi fikr deb o'ylayman.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Menimcha, moliyaviy savodxonlikni maktab o'quv dasturiga majburiy fan sifatida kiritish arziydigan harakatdir. Ko'plab yoshlar asosiy moliyaviy tamoyillarni yaxshi tushunmasdan hayotga qadam qo'yadilar, bu esa keyinchalik o'z moliyalarini boshqarishda qiyinchiliklarga olib kelishi mumkin.

Byudjetlashtirish, investitsiya qilish va qarzni boshqarish kabi mavzularni yoshroq yoshda kiritish talabalarni asosli moliyaviy qarorlar qabul qilish uchun zarur vositalar bilan ta'minlaydi. Misol uchun, murakkab foizlarning oqibatlarini tushunish erta tejashga undashi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, turli xil investitsiya variantlari haqida bilish odamlarga o'z boyliklarini mas'uliyat bilan oshirish imkoniyatini beradi.

Ba'zilar moliyaviy ta'lim ota-onalarning mas'uliyati, deb ta'kidlashi mumkin, ammo bu har doim ham mumkin emas yoki samarali emas, chunki barcha ota-onalarda zarur bilimlar mavjud emas yoki bu ko'nikmalarni o'rgatishni ustuvor deb bilishmaydi. Buni majburiy fanga aylantirish orqali maktablar barcha talabalarning kelib chiqishidan qat'i nazar, ushbu muhim ma'lumotga ega bo'lishini ta'minlashi mumkin. Oxir oqibat, bu moliyaviy jihatdan savodli va mas'uliyatli jamiyatga hissa qo'shadi.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who just got a new pet. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! Congratulations on your new puppy! Having a pet is such a rewarding experience. I recently found this amazing grooming salon called PawPerfect. They were incredibly gentle with my dog and he actually enjoyed it! You should definitely check them out when your puppy needs grooming. Take care!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Nodira,
Dog! Good! I have dog. I go groom. Good shop. Dog clean. Bye.
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Nodira,
You have a new pet! That's good. I have a pet too. I go to a new shop for my pet. It's called PawPerfect. It's good and my pet is happy. You can go there too. Bye!
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Nodira,
I heard you got a new pet, congratulations! It's really fun to have a pet. I recently tried a new grooming salon and I think it's great. It's called PawPerfect. They are very nice and the price is good. You should check it out when your pet needs grooming. Let me know what you think!
t11.sampleB2: Hi Nodira, Congratulations on your new puppy — I bet you're over the moon! Looking after a pet is such a rewarding experience, though it can be hard work at first. When your little one needs a trim, you should check out PawPerfect. The staff are lovely and my dog absolutely loved it. Let me know how it goes! Take care, Ozoda Nazarova

t11.uzSampleB1:

Eshitishimcha, yangi uy hayvoni olibsiz, tabriklayman! Uy hayvoniga ega bo'lish juda qiziqarli. Yaqinda men yangi grooming salonini sinab ko'rdim va menimcha, u juda zo'r. U PawPerfect deb nomlanadi. Salom Nodira,
Yangi uy hayvoningiz haqida eshitib juda xursand bo'ldim! Mo'ynali do'stga ega bo'lish haqiqatan ham ajoyib. Sizga bir tavsiya bermoqchiman – yaqinda uy hayvonimni PawPerfect deb nomlangan yangi sartaroshxonaga olib bordim va men juda ta'sirlandim. Xodimlar do'stona va professional edilar va butun tajriba hayratlanarli darajada yoqimli bo'ldi. Yangi do'stingizga ozgina parvarish kerak bo'lsa, ularni sinab ko'rishni maslahat beraman. Agar shunday qilsangiz, fikringizni menga bildiring!
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Ozoda Nazarova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the pet grooming salon. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear PawPerfect Team, Thank you for your email regarding my recent visit to your grooming salon. I am extremely pleased with the service my dog received. Your staff were exceptionally friendly and clearly love animals. The online booking system was convenient and I particularly appreciated receiving photo updates during the grooming session. However, I would like to suggest some improvements. The waiting area was quite small and crowded with other pets, which made my dog anxious. Perhaps separate waiting spaces could help nervous animals. Additionally, I would appreciate if you offered pet dental cleaning services and nail trimming packages at discounted rates for regular customers. Overall, my experience was positive and I will certainly return. Yours sincerely, Ozoda Nazarova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi PawPerfect Team,
My dog happy. Staff good. Thank you.
Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Dear PawPerfect Team,
Thank you for email. I like the grooming for my dog. The staff are nice and friendly and my dog is happy. But the booking was difficult because the website is slow. I think you need a better website. Also, I want you to sell dog toys. Thank you.
Bye,
Ozoda Nazarova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear PawPerfect Team,

Thank you for your email. I'm writing to you about my dog's grooming. I think the staff were very friendly and did a good job. My dog looks great! The booking process was easy, which was good.

However, I think the prices are a little high. Also, it would be good if you offered longer opening hours, maybe on Saturdays. I would also like it if you sold more dog accessories, like collars and leads.

Overall, I was happy with the service.

Sincerely,
Ozoda Nazarova
t12.sampleB2: Dear PawPerfect Team, Thank you for your kind email following my recent visit. I would like to share my feedback on the service my dog received. Overall, I was extremely pleased. Your staff were exceptionally friendly and clearly love animals, and the online booking system made the whole process refreshingly simple. I particularly appreciated the photo updates during the session. That said, I would like to suggest a couple of improvements. The waiting area felt rather cramped, which left my dog a little on edge; separate spaces for nervous animals could make a real difference. In addition, I would welcome discounted rates on nail trimming and dental cleaning for regular customers. All in all, it was a positive experience, and I will certainly be coming back. Yours sincerely, Ozoda Nazarova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli PawPerfect jamoasi,

Grooming saloningizga yaqinda tashrif buyurganim haqidagi elektron pochta xabaringiz uchun rahmat.

Mening itim olgan xizmatdan juda mamnunman. Sizning xodimlaringiz juda do'stona va hayvonlarni sevishlari aniq edi. Onlayn bron qilish tizimi qulay edi va grooming jarayonida foto yangiliklarini olganimdan ayniqsa xursand bo'ldim.

Biroq, ba'zi takliflarim bor. Kutish joyi juda kichik va boshqa uy hayvonlari bilan gavjum edi, bu mening itimni xavotirga soldi. Ehtimol, alohida kutish joylari asabiy hayvonlarga yordam berishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, agar siz muntazam mijozlar uchun chegirmali narxlarda uy hayvonlarining tishlarini tozalash xizmatlari va tirnoqlarni kesish paketlarini taklif qilsangiz, minnatdor bo'lardim.

Umuman olganda, tajribam ijobiy bo'ldi va albatta qaytib kelaman.

Hurmat bilan,

Ozoda Nazarova

Lekin veb-sayt sekin ishlagani uchun buyurtma berish qiyin bo'ldi. O'ylashimcha, sizga yaxshiroq veb-sayt kerak. Shuningdek, siz it o'yinchoqlarini sotishingizni xohlayman. Rahmat.

Hurmatli PawPerfect jamoasi,

Xatingiz uchun rahmat. Men sizga itimning parvarishi haqida yozmoqdaman. Menimcha, xodimlar juda mehribon edilar va yaxshi ishladilar. Mening itim ajoyib ko'rinadi! Bron qilish jarayoni oson edi, bu yaxshi.

Biroq, men narxlar biroz yuqori deb o'ylayman. Shuningdek, agar siz uzoqroq ish vaqtini, masalan, shanba kunlari taklif qilsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi. Men, shuningdek, agar siz ko'proq it aksessuarlarini, masalan, yoqalar va bog'ichlar sotsangiz, xohlardim.

Umuman olganda, men xizmatdan mamnun bo'ldim.

Hurmat bilan,
Ozoda Nazarova
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli PawPerfect jamoasi,

Xat yuborganingiz uchun rahmat. Men sizning grooming saloningizda yaqinda olgan tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman.

Umuman olganda, mening itim olgan grooming sifatidan mamnun bo'ldim. Xodimlar professional va e'tiborli edi, natijalar esa a'lo darajada bo'ldi. Onlayn bron qilish tizimi sodda va samarali edi, bu menga juda yoqdi.

Biroq, takliflarim bor. Birinchidan, salon juda shovqinli edi, bu mening itimni biroz xavotirga soldi. Ehtimol, shovqin darajasini kamaytirish choralari foydali bo'lishi mumkin. Ikkinchidan, men ixtisoslashgan grooming xizmatlarining kengroq assortimentini, masalan, tullashni kamaytirish muolajalari yoki zotga xos soch turmaklarini ko'rishni xohlardim. Qayta-qayta keladigan mijozlar uchun chegirmalar bilan sodiqlik dasturi ham yaxshi qo'shimcha bo'lar edi.

Ushbu kichik kamchiliklarga qaramay, men xizmatdan qoniqdim va sizning saloningizdan yana foydalanishni o'ylab ko'raman.

Hurmat bilan,
Ozoda Nazarova
